en: Black‑and‑white (with red caption) postcard view of a long, four‑story military barracks building lining a broad, mostly empty street. The structure has a fortified, castellated roofline and many evenly spaced windows. A few pedestrians walk along the sidewalk with small pruned trees planted in front of the building. The printed red text at the top identifies the barracks and the town on the Elbe River.
